flora: Tōtara 'Berry' (a green seed sitting on a bright red, swollen fleshy base)
Prickly foliage (stiff, linear, sharp-pointed needles arranged spirally)
Tōtara sapling (bushy and very prickly, deterrent to herbivores)
Bark detail (thick, stringy, deeply furrowed bark that peels in long strips)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'stiff' and 'sharp' nature of the needles; vibrant red seed base; very textured, rugged bark; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The red fleshy seed base; Top-Right: A close-up of the stiff, prickly needles; Bottom-Left: A bushy young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the deeply furrowed, stringy bark.
visual_logic.ground: Dry red-brown mudstone with fragments of ochre siltstone.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to highlight the deep ridges in the bark.
